samples.xml_description:
<module id="freq_div_even">
    <description>A frequency divider for even numbers, providing a new clock signal with reduced frequency compared to the original clock.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">An active-low reset signal used to initialize the divider.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">The divided clock output signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="NUM_DIV">The division factor (even number). It must be greater than or equal to 2.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <implementation>Reset the counter to 0 when rst_n is low. Increment cnt when clk rises. Toggle clk_div when cnt reaches NUM_DIV - 1.</implementation>
</module>
